capabilities: Convert PST emails into Markdown notes
Save email attachments into the vault
Preserve PST folder structure in the vault
Generate YAML frontmatter with sender, date, and other fields
Incrementally sync new mail from a staging PST with duplicate protection
extras: README is bilingual (Chinese and English) with import-time estimates for large PST files; installable via BRAT as well as the community plugin store.
intentEvidence: an alternative for workflows where Microsoft Copilot is not in use
problem: Obsidian has no way to read Outlook PST email archives, so past email cannot become searchable, linkable vault content.

relations.evidence: process it with AI plugins such as Claudian
an alternative for workflows where Microsoft Copilot is not in use
In Outlook, create a staging PST and use rules to copy new mail into it

summary: Email importer that converts Outlook PST archives into Markdown notes with YAML metadata, attachments, wikilinks, and incremental sync via a staging PST.
